output_conventions.station_rollup_rule: Use parent_station when present; otherwise use stop_id as the station identity.

panel_rules.eligible_station_scope: For each route_id and direction_id, include every rolled-up station that has at least one in-scope departure event in any configured window during the analysis window.
panel_rules.zero_fill_rule: For each active service_date, route_id, direction_id, eligible station, and configured window, output one row even when scheduled_trip_count is zero.
panel_rules.first_last_time_rule: Populate first_departure_local and last_departure_local from in-window departure events for the row. Leave them blank when the row is zero-filled.

terminal_origin_rules.derive_candidates_from: Use the first stop of each trip after station rollup.
terminal_origin_rules.candidate_window_filter_basis: Use the first-stop departure time on the GTFS service-day clock.
